title: Context-Augmented, Session-Calibrated Blood Pressure Tracking from Photoplethysmography
abstract: arXiv:2610.29091v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Objective.To distinguish the contributions of acquisition context and photoplethysmography (PPG) to session-calibrated blood pressure (BP) tracking.Approach. The original comparison used three repeats of five-fold participant-level cross-validation in 653 AuroraBP participants, excluding calibration-labelled prediction targets. Matched analyses separated context and PPG and removed elapsed-time terms. Later exploratory follow-ups retained PPG, accelerometer signals and three initial cuff readings. Separate studies evaluated pulse-rate fusion and an intraoperative VitalDB model. Main results.The original wearable-state model achieved participant-level mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 7.697/6.139 mmHg for systolic/diastolic BP (SBP/DBP). Added context reduced MAE by 0.436/0.126 mmHg (97.5% intervals 0.305-0.573/0.053-0.200). translated_title: 基于光电容积描记法的上下文增强、会话校准血压追踪
translated_abstract: 目的：区分采集上下文与光电容积描记法（PPG）信号对会话校准血压（BP）追踪的各自贡献。方法：原始比较在653名AuroraBP参与者中采用了三次重复的五折参与者层面交叉验证，并排除了带校准标签的预测目标。匹配分析将上下文与PPG的贡献分离，并去除了时间流逝相关项。后续的探索性研究保留了PPG、加速度计信号以及三个初始袖带读数。另外的独立研究评估了脉率融合和术中VitalDB模型。主要结果：原始可穿戴状态模型在收缩压/舒张压（SBP/DBP）上实现了参与者层面平均绝对误差（MAE）7.697/6.139 mmHg。加入上下文信息使MAE降低了0.436/0.126 mmHg（97.5%置信区间为0.305-0.573/0.053-0.200）。在没有外部PPG先验的匹配因子分析中，PPG在……方面优于校准、时间和方案提供的体位信息（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究通过匹配因子分析将采集上下文与PPG信号对会话校准血压追踪的贡献分离，证明PPG信号与上下文信息结合可显著降低血压估计的平均绝对误差。
en_tdlr: This study disentangles the separate contributions of acquisition context and PPG signals to session-calibrated blood pressure tracking, demonstrating that PPG combined with context information significantly reduces blood pressure estimation errors.
